name: Black Bear
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Languages none.
appearance: A dark-furred bear with rounded ears and a lighter brown muzzle.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Player's Handbook, August 2014 first printing, Appendix D, p. 304.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Official errata: The Player's Handbook v3.0 errata raises the attack bonus of Bite and Claws to +4.

name: Cat
appearance: A slender gray-brown tabby with a ringed tail and pale paws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Player's Handbook, August 2014 first printing, Appendix D, p. 305.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack +0, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 1 slashing damage.

name: Constrictor Snake
appearance: A thick olive-brown snake coiled low, with dark blotches and a broad head.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Player's Handbook, August 2014 first printing, Appendix D, p. 305.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapple the target. The creature is restrained until the grapple ends. The snake can constrict only one target at a time. The Player's Handbook stat block gives no fixed escape DC.

name: Giant Weasel
publication: DDEX1-09 - Outlaws of the Iron Route
appearance: A chestnut weasel with a cream throat, long belly and raised, curling tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Outlaws of the Iron Route, DDEX1-9, December 2014, Appendix 1, p. 26.
sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. The weasel has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter: The caverns hold three kobolds and five giant weasels, three of them chained. At the first sign of trouble, a kobold rushes to free them. The weasels attack anyone who threatens their handlers. For a very weak or weak party, remove one weasel. For a very strong party, add one.

name: Spider
publication: DDEX1-09 - Outlaws of the Iron Route
appearance: A small mottled tan spider with a rounded abdomen and eight thin, banded legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Outlaws of the Iron Route, DDEX1-9, December 2014, Appendix 1, p. 31.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature touching it.
Web Walker. Webbing does not impede its movement.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage. On a failed DC 9 Constitution save, the target also takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Encounter: One kobold can throw its spider jar up to 20 ft. Make a ranged improvised-weapon attack against a creature or object. On a hit the jar shatters for 1 piercing damage. Roll 1d6 for the spiders that land on the target. Each spider attacks once and then skitters away.
